requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests validating that prescription behavior schema objects conform to the TypeScript interfaces defined in EVAL-P-RX-UX-S1.
The system must verify via unit tests that transformation logic correctly normalizes prescribing pattern values into display-ready formats.
The system must verify via unit tests that condition mappings are correctly converted into human-readable labels.
The system must verify via unit tests that score contribution calculations produce consistent and deterministic outputs for identical inputs.
The system must execute integration tests confirming that the prescription behavior component renders within MessageBubble when valid structured data is provided.
The system must verify via integration tests that all expected UI elements (patterns, conditions, score contribution) are present when complete data is provided.
The system must verify via integration tests that the component renders in the correct position within the MessageBubble content flow.
The system must execute tests confirming that partial prescription data (missing one or more fields) results in graceful fallback rendering without runtime errors.
The system must execute tests confirming that completely missing prescription data does not render the component and does not break MessageBubble rendering.
The system must verify via unit tests that invalid data types in schema inputs are rejected or handled according to defined validation rules.
The system must ensure all unit and integration tests pass in the CI test environment before merge.
The system must verify via integration tests that no console errors or warnings are emitted during rendering of the prescription behavior component.
The system must verify via unit tests that transformation logic handles empty arrays and null values without throwing exceptions.
The system must ensure test coverage includes both happy path scenarios and at least two distinct edge cases involving missing and malformed data.
